verdict.rationale: Jan lets users connect to remote providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax) and switch freely between local and frontier models, so large models can run remotely without downloading weights. This works only through third-party provider integrations, not a Jan-hosted cloud tier, and nothing in the evidence ties it to cases where local hardware falls short. Missing for 10: a first-party hosted cloud tier for running large open models, guidance or automatic fallback when local hardware is insufficient, and independent corroboration of the cloud workflow.
